proved: OpenAI and xAI continuation append function_call_output with the exact provider-issued call_id, force store false, and omit previous_response_id.
Anthropic continuation appends an assistant tool_use followed immediately by a user tool_result bound through the exact tool_use_id.
Gemini continuation appends function_result with the exact call_id and replays the required native-held interaction steps while forcing store false and omitting previous_interaction_id.
Only the exact frozen source snapshot objects already included in the approved provider request are searchable; a foreign or altered snapshot is rejected.
The model can request only bounded case-sensitive literal search and receives bounded context; the executor has no Drive, filesystem, MCP, plugin, editor, network, or shared-mutation handle.
Custom proposals remain schema-only, domain-unreviewed, executable-false, and cannot shadow the reserved native tool name.
Provider replay and pending tool proposals remain in bounded native process memory; the webview supplies only the original thread call ID and a new call ID, never result bytes or replay state.
Replay above 8 MiB or 256 provider items is rejected before it can enter the pending native registry.

Random native pending-generation IDs use compare-before-consume semantics, so a stale concurrent dialog cannot delete a replacement turn; cancelling disclosure retains the reviewed proposal for retry until expiry.
A fresh native result disclosure is required each turn, pending state expires after ten minutes, at most 32 threads are retained, and continuation stops after four turns.
Content-free provider run records extend v1 backward-compatibly with paired optional bounded turn/thread-hash metadata and reject partial or streamed metadata.
MCP platform contracts report this narrow capability and its watchdog-wrapped self-check separately from generic tool execution and live-provider proof.
notProved: Packaged native Send once or Send results once dialog interaction on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
Live OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or xAI request behavior, provider policy compliance, retention, billing, rate limits, or model willingness to use the tool correctly.
Streaming tool continuation, arbitrary custom-tool execution, server-side tools, Drive/filesystem retrieval, MCP/plugin calls, editor actions, or shared-project mutations.
Retry or recovery after network dispatch; a process restart intentionally discards pending native replay, and a failed post-dispatch call may have ambiguous provider/billing state.
Safety or truth of text returned from the frozen source; it remains untrusted prompt-injection-capable research content already disclosed to the same provider.
Any feature-parity, model-quality, or superiority claim.
